thread:
Ravi (People Ops): Quick FYI 1:00 UTC - ATS export to our hiring analytics pipeline started failing this morning with a 403. Seeing a bunch of missing scorecards in the daily report. Anyone else?
Lena (Recruiter): I noticed too when I pulled the daily CSV. Some candidates have blank score columns. I opened a GH ticket but tagging here in case it's a permissions drift.
Oscar (Hiring Manager): That's causing a problem for today's calibration. Can we get a manual export until fixed?
Nia (Recruiting Ops): I'm looking at the ATS service account. It looks like its API token got rotated by the infra rotation job last night but the new token wasn't added to the export runner secrets. Oops.
Ravi (People Ops): Ok that explains the 403. Nia, can you add the token and restart the job? Also let's capture the window so we know which candidates might be missing scorecards.
Nia (Recruiting Ops): Restarted job and re-ran yesterday's export. Manual diff shows ~12 debrief rows were empty. I re-ingested the corrected CSVs.
ci-bot: :white_check_mark: Export job succeeded on retry. Job run id: 2026-03-23-47.
Lena (Recruiter): Thanks. Quick ask: can we add a pre-export sanity check that validates non-empty score fields? Even a warning would help before we finalize reports.
Nia (Recruiting Ops): Yeah I can add a small check to the runner: if more than 2% of interviews lack scores, fail fast and post a slack alert to #people-ops. Will do a PR today.
Oscar (Hiring Manager): Also, could people-ops remind interviewers to use the scorecard properly? Two of the blank rows were due to interviewers skipping numeric fields and leaving notes only. A one-page refresher would help.
Ravi (People Ops): Good point. I'll send a short training blurb and update the interviewer quick-check checklist: verify numeric rubric fields, don't paste "7/10" into comments (use the numeric field).
Lena (Recruiter): I'll follow up with the interviewers involved and make sure they attend the 15-min refresher tomorrow 10am PT.
Ravi (People Ops): Action items: Nia - add pre-export sanity check (PR by EOD). Lena - reach out to interviewers. Ravi - update training blurb. Closing loop when PR merges.
Nia (Recruiting Ops): PR opened: https://go.redwood/pr/1223 - includes alerting and a low-noise threshold.
ci-bot: :rocket: PR 1223 deployed to staging.
